title: Test-Time Scaling of Reasoning Models for Machine Translation
authors_zh: Zihao Li、Shaoxiong Ji、Jörg Tiedemann（机构：University of Helsinki、ELLIS Institute Finland、University of Turku）
paper_type_zh: 跨领域测试时扩展评测研究（EACL 2026）
best_for_zh: 检验推理预算能否迁移到数学和代码之外任务的读者。
one_line: This study shows that test-time reasoning helps translation mainly with task-specialized models and post-editing, not by indiscriminately lengthening thought.
该研究表明，测试时推理在翻译中主要通过任务专化模型与后编辑发挥作用，而非无差别延长思考。
why: It identifies boundary conditions under which more inference computation becomes useful rather than wasteful.
inclusion_reason: It measures when additional inference-time reasoning budget helps, plateaus, or harms a concrete task and compares direct generation with self-correcting post-editing.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reasoning models often improve on mathematics and code when given extra inference-time computation, but translation has different failure modes. It requires linguistic fidelity, terminology, cultural context, and long-range coherence; a longer chain of thought can introduce noise rather than repair a draft. Existing claims about test-time scaling therefore do not establish that simply assigning more thinking tokens yields better translation.

The paper asks when additional reasoning budget helps translation, when it merely plateaus, and when it makes quality worse. It contrasts direct one-pass translation, forced extrapolation beyond a model’s natural stopping point, and two-stage post-editing. The central decision is not whether a model can think longer, but which workflow should consume that extra computation.

推理模型在数学和代码上得到额外推理时计算时常能改进，但翻译具有不同失效模式。它需要语言忠实度、术语、文化语境和长程连贯性；更长的思维链可能引入噪声，而不是修复草稿。因此，关于测试时扩展的既有主张不能证明仅分配更多思考词元就会带来更好的翻译。

论文追问额外推理预算何时帮助翻译、何时只会趋于平台、何时反而降低质量。它比较直接的一次翻译、超出模型自然停止点的强制延长和两阶段后编辑。核心决策不是模型能否想得更久，而是哪种工作流应消耗额外计算。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The study treats test-time scaling as task- and workflow-dependent rather than a universal quality knob. For general-purpose reasoning models, direct translation receives only small, inconsistent gains before performance and actual thinking length plateau. Forcing another thought with a “wait” intervention is not neutral: it overrides the model’s own stopping decision and consistently harms translation quality in the reported experiments.

In contrast, domain-specific fine-tuning aligns a model’s reasoning behavior with a translation task, allowing quality to rise up to a self-determined reasoning depth. A post-editing workflow also turns extra computation into a useful second pass: the model reviews an existing translation rather than trying to lengthen the first one indefinitely. The paper thus locates value in targeted self-correction, not unrestricted thought extension.

研究把测试时扩展视为依赖任务和工作流的机制，而不是通用的质量旋钮。对于通用推理模型，直接翻译在性能和实际思考长度趋于平台前只获得很小且不一致的收益。用“wait”干预强迫再思考并非中性：它覆盖模型自身的停止决定，并在报告实验中持续损害翻译质量。

相反，领域专化微调会使模型推理行为与翻译任务对齐，让质量上升到一个自行决定的推理深度。后编辑工作流也把额外计算转化为有用的第二遍：模型审阅现有译文，而不是无限延长第一遍思考。因此，论文把价值定位于定向自我纠正，而非不受限制地延长思考。

title: Method
方法
html:
The authors evaluate twelve reasoning models over eight translation benchmarks spanning literary, biomedical, cultural, commonsense, terminology, and retrieval-augmented settings. They regulate a model’s reasoning inside its thinking span with a token budget, record actual reasoning length, and optionally insert one “wait” token when the model would stop. Translation quality is measured with reference-based and reference-free COMET variants plus an LLM judge and literary-specific metrics.

They compare direct translation with post-editing, where a second stage receives the source and the model’s own draft; one variant also includes a quality score for the draft. The experiments separate general-purpose models from DRT models fine-tuned for translation. This exposes a concrete budget decision: spend inference on a first-pass chain of thought, force an additional continuation, or use another pass to inspect and revise a completed translation.

作者在八个翻译基准上评估十二个推理模型，基准覆盖文学、生物医学、文化、常识、术语和检索增强设定。他们用词元预算调节模型在思考段内的推理，记录实际思考长度，并可在模型本会停止时插入一个“wait”词元。翻译质量由基于参考和无参考的 COMET 变体、语言模型评审及文学专用指标衡量。

他们比较直接翻译与后编辑：第二阶段接收源文本和模型自身草稿；一种变体还提供草稿质量分数。实验把通用模型与为翻译微调的 DRT 模型分开。这暴露出具体预算决策：把计算花在首遍思维链、强迫一次额外延续，或用第二遍检查并修订已完成的译文。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across general-purpose Qwen-3, Cogito, and Grok-3-Mini settings, the paper finds limited and dataset-dependent direct-translation gains from larger reasoning budgets. Models often stop near their own reasoning ceiling even when allocated far more tokens, and one forced “wait” beyond the natural stop consistently degrades reported quality. These observations make a negative result valuable: additional test-time compute is not automatically productive outside tasks with easily verifiable answers.

The paper reports a different pattern for translation-specialized DRT models on their in-domain task, where quality rises with budget until natural thinking length saturates. It also finds post-editing reliably beneficial despite costing a second stage. The evidence supports a conditional recommendation, not a universal scaling law; performance depends on domain training, the translation workflow, and the evaluation metric used.

在通用 Qwen-3、Cogito 和 Grok-3-Mini 设定中，论文发现更大推理预算对直接翻译的收益有限且依赖数据集。即使被分配更多词元，模型常在自身推理上限附近停止；自然停止后强插一个“wait”也持续降低报告的质量。这些观察使负结果很有价值：额外推理时计算并不会在答案容易验证之外的任务中自动产生价值。

论文在领域内任务上的翻译专化 DRT 模型中报告了不同模式：质量随预算上升，直到自然思考长度饱和。它还发现后编辑尽管需要第二阶段，仍可靠有益。证据支持的是条件性建议，而非普适扩展定律；性能依赖领域训练、翻译工作流和所用评价指标。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is a boundary study of test-time scaling, not a claim that longer thought universally improves generation. By testing direct translation, forced extrapolation, fine-tuned models, and post-editing in one protocol, the work makes workflow choice part of the inference-time compute decision. It identifies that an apparently simple intervention—forcing a model past its stopping point—can be systematically counterproductive.

It also distinguishes two ways of using extra budget that are often conflated: lengthening the same reasoning episode and initiating a revision episode over a concrete draft. The latter gives the model an object to criticize and repair, whereas the former can amplify unresolved uncertainty. This distinction is useful for designing test-time systems in non-verifiable domains where a final answer cannot be selected by an exact checker.

贡献是一项测试时扩展的边界研究，而不是声称更长思考普遍改善生成。通过在同一协议中测试直接翻译、强制延长、微调模型和后编辑，工作让工作流选择成为推理时计算决策的一部分。它识别出一种看似简单的干预——强迫模型越过停止点——可能系统性地适得其反。

它还区分两种常被混淆的额外预算使用方式：延长同一次推理，以及针对具体草稿启动一次修订。后者给模型一个可批评和修复的对象，而前者可能放大未解决的不确定性。这一区分有助于在终端答案不能由精确检查器选择的不可验证领域设计推理时系统。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The conclusions concern the reported translation models, languages, prompts, and automatic or LLM-based metrics; a different quality target, such as human literary preference, may change the observed optimum. The paper evaluates controlled budget forcing rather than every possible search or verification strategy, and its translation-specialized result is strongest in-domain. Post-editing also adds latency and can propagate a bad first draft. A deployment should therefore measure user-facing quality and cost separately rather than infer that any second pass is beneficial.
结论针对报告中的翻译模型、语言、提示以及自动或语言模型指标；不同质量目标，例如人类文学偏好，可能改变观察到的最优点。论文评估的是受控预算强制，而非所有可能的搜索或验证策略，其翻译专化结果在领域内最强。后编辑也会增加延迟，并可能传播糟糕的首版草稿。因此，部署应分别测量面向用户的质量与成本，而不能推断任何第二遍都必然有益。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when deciding whether a translation system should buy more internal thinking or an explicit revision pass. Log allocated and actual thinking tokens, natural stopping points, direct and post-edited outputs, each quality metric, and end-to-end latency. Compare fixed-budget direct translation with naturally stopped reasoning and a matched-cost post-editing pipeline. The work is especially useful as a caution against importing math-oriented “think longer” recipes into translation without checking whether the model has task-specific reasoning competence.
当决定翻译系统应购买更多内部思考还是明确的修订阶段时，可使用这篇论文。应记录分配和实际思考词元、自然停止点、直接与后编辑输出、每项质量指标及端到端延迟。在固定预算直接翻译、自然停止推理与成本匹配的后编辑流程之间比较。该工作尤其提醒人们：不要把面向数学的“想得更久”配方直接搬到翻译中，而不检查模型是否具有任务专化推理能力。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the actual-token curves beside quality curves. A requested budget is not the same as a budget the model uses, and a plateau may reflect either natural stopping or a lack of useful task knowledge. Inspect the direct-translation, forced-wait, and post-editing prompts separately, as they represent different interventions. A faithful replication should stratify in-domain and out-of-domain tasks, report multiple translation metrics, and match total tokens across workflows. That design reveals whether a gain comes from more computation, better task alignment, or merely a second opportunity to rewrite.
应把实际词元曲线与质量曲线放在一起读。请求的预算不等于模型实际使用的预算，而平台可能反映自然停止，也可能反映缺乏有用的任务知识。需要分别检查直接翻译、强制 wait 和后编辑提示，因为它们代表不同干预。忠实复现应分层报告领域内与领域外任务、使用多种翻译指标，并在工作流之间匹配总词元。这种设计能揭示收益来自更多计算、更好的任务对齐，还是仅仅来自第二次改写机会。
